title: Structure Record — PhD Thesis Butler v4.0
description: Structural pattern record for a single source document, capturing section sequence, pattern type, and boolean flags.

id.description: Unique structure record ID following convention: structure_{incremental_id}

paper_id.description: Reference to the parent paper_record this structure was extracted from.

section_sequence.description: Ordered array of DIS categories as they appear in the paper. Preserves document order.

discipline.description: Academic discipline extracted from source entries.

cluster.description: Cluster derived from directory path (NOT from _layer field).

section_count.description: Number of distinct categories in section_sequence.

has_intro.description: True if INTRO is present in section_sequence.

has_survey.description: True if SURVEY is present in section_sequence.

has_model.description: True if MODEL is present in section_sequence.

has_method.description: True if METHOD is present in section_sequence.

has_experiment.description: True if EXPERIMENT is present in section_sequence.

has_result.description: True if RESULT is present in section_sequence.

has_discussion.description: True if DISCUSSION is present in section_sequence.

has_conclusion.description: True if CONCLUSION is present in section_sequence.

has_formal_defs.description: True if FORMAL_DEFS is present in section_sequence.

has_engineering.description: True if ENGINEERING is present in section_sequence.

has_transition.description: True if TRANSITION is present in section_sequence.

has_aref.description: True if AREF is present in section_sequence.

has_utils.description: True if UTILS is present in section_sequence.

pattern_type.description: Classified structural pattern type based on section_sequence ordering.
pattern_type.$comment: deductive: MODEL→METHOD→RESULT; inductive: SURVEY→METHOD→RESULT; hypothetico-deductive: SURVEY→MODEL→EXPERIMENT→RESULT

evidence_count.description: Evidence metadata for this structure record.

count.description: Number of papers sharing this exact structure pattern (for aggregated records) or 1 (for per-paper records).

source.description: Source identifier. For private builds: paper_id(s). For public output: 'abstracted'.

confidence.description: Confidence: high (≥30 papers share pattern), medium (10-29), low (<10), pending (not computed).

source.description: Origin institution or collection. For public output: 'abstracted'.
